findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/topology-critic-receipt.ts:117-143 — four-dimensional independence is not mechanically established in production: deriveRoleProvenance hard-codes reviewer businessIdentity to the role string, then independenceMatrix compares that synthetic constant with the implementation commit author. The production path therefore cannot observe or fail closed when the critic/scope approver is the same business author; the smoke only injects a synthetic low-level collision that deriveRoleProvenance can never emit. This violates CHK-001/VI-CRITIC-FOUR-DIMENSION-MATRIX and the Wave 2A stop condition against inferred/self-reported independence.

.claude/agents/lattice-review-topology-critic.md:1 (mirrored in .lattice-codex and packages/main/templates) starts with literal +--- instead of YAML delimiter ---. packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:337-342 requires the first trimmed line to equal ---, so the promised topology-critic host asset cannot be parsed/bootstrapped even though the role is registered. This is an undelivered role entrypoint and must be corrected in all three mirrors with a parser/adapter verification that exercises this template.

packages/main/src/core/topology-critic-receipt.ts:86 critic/scope-plan dispatch provenance is selected only by role+session and is never checked against the current business commit, HEAD, storyFilesHash, or dispatch envelope binding. A previously valid dispatch in the same session can therefore be replayed after a new implementer commit to mint a newly signed receipt/approval for the changed implementation, violating VI-CRITIC-SESSION-DISPATCH-REPLAY and the promised current dispatch provenance. Bind the selected dispatch envelope/event to the implementation/current material and add the production replay mutation that changes the business commit after dispatch.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.ts:142-210 — 21/21 must intents have evidence rows, but the shared smoke does not actually satisfy several claimed contracts. It invokes createProofStoryHandlers directly instead of the registered bin/lattice CLI; the four-dimension cases call the issuer rather than the production verifier; receipt fields are only altered, never individually deleted; signature coverage only replaces signature with forged text (no untrusted re-sign or cross-story/critic/time signature replay); missing/unverifiable signer and implementer provenance is absent; role replay does not cover a different business commit; canonical ref ordering/dedup/nonexistent refs is absent; exclusion coverage only exercises one exclusion and omits zero/multiple, orphan/stale/cross-story plus approver-vs-critic collision/spoof cases; incomplete discovery only covers partial/unsupported, not missing/stale/tampered; restoration is shown only for one approval mutation and never asserts git clean/no reusable forged artifact; process-fact mutations omit the CLI-schema and lifecycle/gate-consumer layers (lines 205-210 only mutate prompt, handler, verifier, incomplete-basis predicate). Add table-driven production-path cases for these missing assertions, including clean→mutation→exact restore, then record fresh intent-specific evidence rather than reusing the broad transcript note.
